## Daten laden

#| label: load-data

base_path <- "C:/Users/user/Documents/Master_EnvironmentalSciences/Master_Thesis"

# ── Gefiltertes Phyloseq-Objekt (ohne Incertae sedis, ohne Grammoptera) ───────
ps <- readRDS(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/Taxonomy_v2/ps_filtered.rds"))

---

## Read Tracking

```{r}
#| label: read-tracking

runs <- c("EC24_245", "3XX", "Popa", "Buse")

track_all <- lapply(runs, function(run) {
  df <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output_v2",
                            run, "read_tracking.csv"))
  df$run <- run
  df
}) %>% bind_rows()

grammoptera_ids <- c("EC24_245_0016_FITS_B04_iA", "EC24_245_0017_FITS_B05_iA",
                     "EC24_245_0018_FITS_B06_iA", "EC24_245_0019_FITS_B07_iA",
                     "EC24_245_0020_FITS_B08_iA", "EC24_245_0021_FITS_B09_iA",
                     "EC24_245_0022_FITS_B10_iA", "EC24_245_0023_FITS_B11_iA")

track_summary <- track_all %>%
  filter(!grepl("NC|negativ|332|333|334", X)) %>%
  filter(!gsub("-", "_", gsub("ns2024-18-", "",
               gsub("_S\\d+_L001$", "", X))) %in% grammoptera_ids) %>%
  group_by(run) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples      = n(),
    reads_input    = sum(Input),
    reads_filtered = sum(Gefiltert),
    reads_merged   = sum(Merged),
    reads_nochim   = sum(Ohne_Chimaeren),
    pct_retained   = round(reads_nochim / reads_input * 100, 1)
  )

print(track_summary)
```

## Taxonomische Zusammensetzung

```{r}
#| label: taxonomy-rates

tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))

# ── Klassifizierungsraten ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("=== Klassifizierungsraten (n =", ntaxa(ps), "ASVs) ===\n")
for (rank in c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")) {
  n <- sum(!is.na(tax_df[[rank]]) & tax_df[[rank]] != "" &
           !grepl("^[kpcofgs]__$", tax_df[[rank]]))
  cat(sprintf("%-10s %5d  (%.1f%%)\n", rank, n, 100 * n / nrow(tax_df)))
}

# ── Phylum-Zusammensetzung ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Phylum-Verteilung ===\n")
phylum_df <- tax_df %>%
  mutate(Phylum_clean = gsub("p__", "", Phylum)) %>%
  count(Phylum_clean, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
         Phylum_clean = fct_reorder(Phylum_clean, n))

print(phylum_df)

# ── Top 15 Genera ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Top 15 Genera ===\n")
genus_df <- tax_df %>%
  mutate(Genus_clean = gsub("g__", "", Genus)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genus_clean) & Genus_clean != "" &
         !grepl("Incertae_sedis", Genus_clean)) %>%
  count(Genus_clean, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  mutate(Genus_clean = fct_reorder(Genus_clean, n))

print(genus_df)
```

---

## Plots: Taxonomie

```{r}
#| label: taxonomy-plots
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6

phylum_colors <- c(
  "Ascomycota"          = "darkgoldenrod2",
  "Basidiomycota"       = "chocolate3",
  "Mortierellomycota"   = "#74C476",
  "Mucoromycota"        = "#A1D99B",
  "Chytridiomycota"     = "#FDD0A2",
  "Rozellomycota"       = "#FDAE6B",
  "Basidiobolomycota"   = "#C7E9C0",
  "Olpidiomycota"       = "#BCBDDC",
  "Sanchytriomycota"    = "#DADAEB",
  "Entomophthoromycota" = "#F7FBFF"
)

plot_phylum <- ggplot(phylum_df,
                      aes(x = n, y = Phylum_clean, fill = Phylum_clean)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors, na.value = "#969696") +
  labs(x = "Number of ASVs", y = NULL) +
  xlim(0, max(phylum_df$n) * 1.15) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "italic")
  )

plot_genus <- ggplot(genus_df, aes(x = n, y = Genus_clean)) +
  geom_col(fill = "bisque3") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
  labs(x = "Number of ASVs", y = NULL) +
  xlim(0, max(genus_df$n) * 1.15) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))

combined_tax <- plot_phylum + plot_genus +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.4, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

combined_tax

ggsave(file.path(base_path, "Results/Figures/taxonomy_combined.pdf"),
       plot = combined_tax, width = 14, height = 6, bg = "white")
```
